_comment: Reviewed classifications for well-known icons. Entries bind to the exact source_sha256 and expire automatically when a package updates its artwork. Machine-specific entries (e.g. absolute-path icons) belong in ~/.local/state/icon-normalizer/overrides.json, which is merged over this file.
